**Is your feature about search, a provider (clipboard/snippets/AI), or a
native host?**

Fulcrum is one Racket brain plus three first-party native UIs (macOS
SwiftUI, Windows WinUI 3, Linux GTK4) — saying which layer helps triage.
中文描述完全没问题。

**Problem you're trying to solve**

What are you trying to do that Fulcrum doesn't let you (or makes hard)?
One keystroke should be all it takes.

**Proposed solution**

What you'd expect, and whether it should behave identically on all three
desktops (or is inherently platform-bound, like window management).

**Alternatives you've considered**

How do you work around it today?

> Fulcrum is source-available under BUSL-1.1 — feature requests are
> welcome; implementation priority is set by the maintainer.
